set.body: Cold review of fcba42c50 (S4), findings 1+2. (1) SpeechPromotion stores predicate.gloss but no digest or identity covers it: two promotions are == while predicate differs (rule 7). Store lemma+frame only, or digest gloss. (2) ContestationSet equality is digest-only and the digest omits record credence/provenance; records keep caller order so first-match Contested messages differ between == sets. Digest all ClaimMeta fields and store records canonically ordered. Also: holdsIn accepts any model status; a ReferentResolution from another model with equal context ids passes the Dialogue check for text supports (record as known limit or bind resolution to model).
set.title: S4 follow-up: promotion and contestation-set identity cover every stored field
